criteria.description_zh: 原印刷数据、原范围与限制保留
有效报价版本、替换关系和待决选项判断
当前成本链、费用基数与费率正确
可核对的新旧成本差额与比较基准
公开价格费率变化后成本链、核对及保护实际响应
原估算与审阅对应材料可追溯

weight_basis: Before any new Agent output: 35 points for meeting-time continued use, 20 for revision/scope judgment, 10 for explainable reconciliation; 35 for source and baseline delivery. No target score or historical answer determines weights.
equivalence: Business-equivalent layout/formula and explicitly identified original printed/recomputed comparison bases accepted; readable rounded displays accepted; static outputs earn baseline facts but not unfulfilled editable-use facts.
external_acceptance: No claim of proven research novelty, public redistribution clearance, general agentic parsing or formal difficulty acceptance.
